# Rezin

Rezin applies a sci-fi style whose stated inspiration is Cyberpunk 2077, with neon accents, high-contrast dark backgrounds and futuristic UI elements. The editor, panes and sidebars are styled together, and only a dark mode is recorded.

![Rezin screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicolasghs/Rezin-theme/HEAD/assets/image.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Rezin"
    author: "nicolasghs"
    repo:   "nicolasghs/Rezin-theme"
    slug:   "rezin"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/rezin"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/nicolasghs/Rezin-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicolasghs/Rezin-theme/HEAD/assets/image.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a sci-fi Cyberpunk 2077–inspired visual style with neon accents, high-contrast dark backgrounds, and futuristic UI elements. Transform editor, panes, and sidebars into a cohesive cyberpunk aesthetic for immersive note-taking."
}
```
